name: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste
tagline: Joining paste for use with the SikaProof® Benontite System
summary: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is a one component paste that forms part of the SikaProof® Bentonite natural sodium bentonite below ground waterproofing system. An efficient, dual purpose bentonite formulation which penetrates into the pores of the SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile layers while providing a thick and substantial hydraulic barrier.
metaDescription: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is a one component paste that forms part of the SikaProof® Bentonite natural sodium bentonite below ground waterproofing system. An efficient, dual purpose bentonite formulation which penetrates into the pores of the SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile layers while providing a thick and substantial hydraulic barrier.
usage: To form watertight overlaps during the installation of SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile roll.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Three (3) years from date of manufacture if stored correctly.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated area, out of direct sunlight. Store in suitable, labelled containers. Keep containers tightly closed. Store away from incompatible materials. Ensure that storage conditions comply with applicable local and national regulations. Protect from freezing.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is part of the SikaProof® Bentonite System, comprising of:
SikaProof® Bentonite 1.1m wide x 10m roll
SikaProof® Bentonite 2.2m wide x 10m roll
SikaProof® Bentonite Paste 20 litre pails
SikaProof® Bentonite Powder 25 kg bags

items.label: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
items.text: Refer to the SikaProof® Bentonite system data sheet and Method Statement for full installation instructions. Note: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste can only be installed by Sika NZ Approved Contractors.
